text:
Elise Park: heads-up team — were lining up the newsletter to accompany the inference benchmark post. want a tight 2-email nurture for inbound signups. main constraints: keep assets small, route trials separately, and timezone-aware sends.
Noah Kim: agree. propose send windows: Americas Thu 10am PT, EMEA Fri 10am CET, APAC Mon 10am HKT. will localize the date strings.
Sam Torres: segmentation: inbound_source=benchmark_post => primary invite. high_intent = clicked_bench_cta OR visited=/benchmarks/docs -> tag bench_high and get immediate invite; others enter 48hr nurture. I'll prepare filters and export Wed 6am PT.
Imani Reed: creative: two hero variants (chart snapshot, engineer photo). need hero line (max 30 chars), 90-char preheader, and CTAs: Register / Read the post. I'll have mockups by Tue evening.
Sam Torres: ops note — suppress active_customers + unsubscribed + bounced_90d. set ESP canary 5% first 10 minutes; pause if bounce_rate > 1%. Also set webhook retries=3.
Elise Park: subject test plan: Variant A (generic): "Benchmark released + live demo"; Variant B (personalized/dev): "How we cut token costs by 3x" -> send B to dev-themed segment.
Noah Kim: add personalization token for first_name with fallback "there". also recommend dynamic subject by engagement tier (high-engage get personalized).
Imani Reed: assets upload: https://drive.redwood/launch/bench-assets (I'll drop imageA.png + imageB.png + templates).
delivery-bot: Calendar event created: "Benchmark launch newsletter" Thu 10:00 PT  invites: #marketing #growth #product.
Sam Torres: webhook payload example for sales tagging: ```{
  "lead_id": "{{id}}",
  "tags": ["bench_high"],
  "source": "benchmark_post"
}```
Elise Park: routing & replay: registrants who miss live -> send replay + 2-line summary 30min after webinar end. non-registrants who clicked the post -> include "Quick Replay" CTA in nurture email 2.
Noah Kim: analytics: track open -> register -> replay. I'll own dashboard and include subject+region breakdown, register velocity, and replay views.
Imani Reed: localization: please provide translated subject + preheader for FR/DE/JP by Tue 18:00 UTC so I can swap into templates.
Sam Torres: export details: CSV with columns: email, first_name, region, source, last_activity, tags. dropping to shared drive by Wed 6am PT.
Elise Park: timeline recap: Tue EOD copy + assets, Wed 6am export, seeds Wed 9am PT, Americas Thu 10am PT, EMEA Fri 10am CET, APAC Mon 10am HKT. owners: Noah (analytics+subjects), Imani (creative+assets), Sam (segmentation+ops), Elise (launch lead).
Noah Kim: quick copy ask: hero line (25 chars) + 90-char preheader. Drafting now and will post in thread for review.
Imani Reed: will prepare templates with localized date placeholders. also building a small alt-text for images for accessibility.
delivery-bot: Reminder: Seeds & ISP checks scheduled 2025-06-18T09:00:00Z.
Elise Park: thanks all  keep QA comments in-thread during the final 3-hour window. :rocket:
